themes.content_purpose: Show how the product belongs in a believable, composed daily routine.
themes.narrative_moment: a small transition or pause with a clear reason to be there
themes.person_presence: adult woman, present as a person rather than a display prop
themes.person_state: relaxed and attentive to the environment or action
themes.gaze_behavior: off-camera or naturally task-focused; direct gaze is occasional only
themes.action_logic: one low-risk action with a physical reason
themes.styling_boundary: complete wearable outfit; no product-color age routing
scene_evidence: object or spatial cue tied to the action
themes.light_language: warm natural daylight with believable shadow
themes.color_language: low-saturation warm neutrals with restrained contrast
themes.material_language: stone, fabric, leather, wood, paper and real surface texture
themes.camera_angle: natural eye-level or slightly lowered product-aware angle
themes.composition_logic: behavior and spatial evidence before product display
themes.product_presence: worn product integrated into the person’s movement
themes.product_visibility_requirement: at least one readable complete product when the task requires on-foot visibility
repetition_controls: do not repeat café as default
do not repeat coffee as the only prop
alternate seated, walking and transitional behavior

themes.content_purpose: Make development judgment visible through restrained material and process evidence.
themes.narrative_moment: a real work pause while reviewing or handling product evidence
themes.person_presence: partial person or hands may appear when the action needs them
themes.person_state: focused on a material or decision
themes.gaze_behavior: directed toward the work, not the viewer
themes.action_logic: touch, compare, arrange or inspect one real object group
themes.styling_boundary: neutral working clothes; no founder-performance portrait
themes.color_language: warm grey, cream, brown and muted natural accents
themes.material_language: suede, leather, stitching, paper, wood and textile grain
themes.composition_logic: one process relationship with deliberate negative space
themes.product_visibility_requirement: the relevant product detail must be structurally readable
repetition_controls: limit props to the stated process
do not repeat a generic desk setup

themes.content_purpose: Explain seasonal styling choices through real garment and material relationships.
themes.narrative_moment: choosing or adjusting a layered outfit before moving into the day
themes.person_presence: adult woman in a complete outfit system
themes.person_state: calmly deciding or checking a combination
themes.gaze_behavior: focused on garment, mirror or environment
themes.action_logic: adjust one layer, hem or accessory with a clear purpose
themes.styling_boundary: seasonal layers support the story but do not define age from the SKU
themes.light_language: soft seasonal daylight, no orange filter
themes.color_language: warm neutrals with one controlled seasonal accent
themes.material_language: wool, cotton, suede, leather, matte knit and soft tailoring
themes.composition_logic: garment and product relationship remains legible
themes.product_visibility_requirement: product must remain identifiable without being enlarged
repetition_controls: do not always use white shirt and beige tote
vary layer and action before changing scene name

themes.content_purpose: Answer a practical styling question through a complete, believable outfit.
themes.narrative_moment: getting dressed, leaving, or checking a resolved outfit
themes.gaze_behavior: task-focused, sideward or naturally toward the outfit
themes.action_logic: one outfit-adjustment action with physical cause
themes.styling_boundary: wearable complete look; no fixed palette or product-led persona
themes.light_language: soft daylight or believable interior light
themes.color_language: warm neutral base with controlled contrast
themes.material_language: matte textile, leather, knit, denim and stone
themes.camera_angle: eye-level, mirror or natural standing angle
themes.composition_logic: the look reads as a system, not a product advertisement
themes.product_presence: worn product integrated in the full look
themes.product_visibility_requirement: complete product visibility when the task is on-foot or full-body
repetition_controls: do not reuse the same café and coffee combination

themes.content_purpose: Make specific construction and material evidence understandable without overclaiming.
themes.narrative_moment: a close inspection of one material or construction relationship
themes.gaze_behavior: toward the object if a face appears
themes.action_logic: touch, lift, turn or compare a specific detail
themes.styling_boundary: product and evidence lead; styling stays secondary
themes.color_language: neutral background with restrained product contrast
themes.material_language: specific leather, suede, stitching and outsole texture
themes.camera_angle: detail, side, heel or top-down angle
themes.composition_logic: one evidence role per frame with sufficient negative space
themes.product_visibility_requirement: the specified detail must be complete and readable
hard_negative_rules: cropped evidence that cannot be judged
repetition_controls: do not use the same lateral profile for every craft story

themes.content_purpose: Express the brand’s way of noticing daily life through concrete visual evidence.
themes.narrative_moment: a quiet observation or ordinary pause with a meaningful material or spatial cue
themes.person_presence: optional person with independent life beyond the product
themes.gaze_behavior: off-camera or toward a real cue
themes.action_logic: small ordinary action; no pose without cause
themes.styling_boundary: brand language is abstract and SKU-neutral
themes.light_language: warm daylight, restrained shadow and real tonal variation
themes.material_language: stone, fabric, wood, paper and natural leather
themes.composition_logic: meaning comes from relation and pause, not decorative emptiness
themes.product_visibility_requirement: if product appears, its evidence source must be explicit
repetition_controls: a product-free frame still needs a brand-relevant observation
avoid repeating the same beige wall

themes.content_purpose: Present a new product clearly within a restrained, useful brand context.
themes.narrative_moment: a controlled introduction or outfit context that helps a viewer understand the product
themes.person_presence: adult model with calm independent presence
themes.action_logic: low-risk stance, small turn or real weight transfer
themes.styling_boundary: complete studio styling that supports product legibility without defining the brand permanently
themes.light_language: controlled warm-grey studio light with readable shadows
themes.color_language: quiet neutral background and accurate task product colors
themes.material_language: clean textile, leather and matte studio surface
themes.camera_angle: front, back or three-quarter according to task
themes.composition_logic: clear product and body relationship with negative space
themes.product_visibility_requirement: required evidence role must be fully visible
repetition_controls: front view is not the only studio role
rotate front, back, lower-third and three-quarter evidence

themes.content_purpose: Supply controlled scene variations to formal themes without replacing their semantic purpose.
themes.narrative_moment: inherited from the owning formal theme
themes.person_presence: inherited from the owning formal theme
themes.person_state: inherited from the owning formal theme
themes.gaze_behavior: inherited from the owning formal theme
themes.action_logic: scene entry supplies evidence, not a standalone theme purpose
themes.styling_boundary: inherited from the owning formal theme
themes.composition_logic: scene must serve the formal theme purpose
repetition_controls: scene pool entries cannot bypass theme QA
limit repeated café, hotel and coffee combinations
